name: Starlink Group 15-22
slot_a_text: B1082 on its 24th flight. Perfect 23 for 23 on landings. Last flew Starlink Group 17-39 35 days ago. Targeting OCISLY, 574 km downrange.
slot_b_text: B1082 has flown 23 times over 31 months. Its flights break down as twenty Starlink, one USSF, one OneWeb, and one other. Its quickest turnaround was 25 days. Only two cores in the fleet have flown more.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: SpaceX's Falcon 9 uses grid fins cast from a single piece of titanium so strong they are rarely replaced.
